title: Zigzagging light during Fourth of July fireworks
place_text: park along a wash near Barth's home

tellings.quote: gave back to me and it goes it starts into a zigzag

plain: During Fourth of July fireworks in 2000, at a park along a dry creek bed near his home, a light started moving in a zigzag, according to Richard Barth, a former nuclear missile guard who says he was abducted by aliens. Barth says he saw it himself, mentions a man named Roger in the telling, and describes how "it starts into a zigzag," a movement fireworks would not make.
